summary: Add Core-side support for seeding packaged virtio-win media and pre-selecting an available driver disc, but exclude the ISO from the 0.2.9 public installer until complete corresponding source is retained. Operators can import a driver ISO through the existing media API. API impact: existing contract — drivers_media_id, iso-import, inventory and adoption contracts are unchanged.

guide.reason: The VM guides retain the second-driver-disc workflow and now state that 0.2.9 does not bundle virtio-win; operators import their own driver ISO.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Operator imports and any future compliant seed use the existing iso-import journal and inventory adoption path; drivers_media_id and media-list contracts are unchanged. The 0.2.9 installer supplies no bundled ISO.

roadmap.reason: The platform and readiness plans keep the second driver-disc capability complete but reopen automatic virtio-win bundling until corresponding-source retention is complete.

state.reason: Imported driver media is a Core-owned iso-import journal entry on the pool master. The 0.2.9 installer creates no bundled-media entry.
state.record: Managed journal iso-import entry and media file under the selected Core storage registration; no bundled virtio-win record is created by 0.2.9.
state.adoption: Inventory reports the media entry; a fresh Controller adopts it through the existing adoptManaged media path.

verification.method: Core seed and UI-selection unit checks pass for an available media record. The release regression check proves installer/build.sh does not stage virtio-win media or source inputs. The final 0.2.9 ISO inspection confirms no virtio-win ISO is present. Automatic bundling remains unaccepted until complete corresponding source and notices are retained.
